families.name: Mackenzie Investments
families.notes: Most predictable publisher found. URL form: /content/dam/mackenzie/en/pfic/pfic-{YEAR}-{CODE}-en.pdf Both EN and FR posted; we take EN. Statements are not mailed to investors.

families.name: TD Asset Management
families.notes: Path root has moved between years (/content/dam/tdcom/... and /ca/en/asset-management/documents/...). Both are matched; content verification decides what is real.

families.name: Vanguard Investments Canada
families.notes: Two hosts in play: fund-docs.vanguard.com (older) and www.vanguard.ca/content/dam/... (current). Ticker embedded in filename.

families.name: Russell Investments Canada
families.notes: Year is a path segment - /legal/{YEAR}/pfic/. Fund code often prefixes the filename.

families.name: CI Global Asset Management
families.notes: Hub is ~17MB and links the entire CI document catalog (~15k PDFs), so the include filter is doing heavy lifting. Fund identity lives in an opaque numeric path segment, so identity must come from PDF text, not the URL.

families.name: Mawer Investment Management
families.notes: Served from an Azure CDN. Path changed between years: 2023 -> /assets/documents/{fund}-pfic-reporting-dec-31-2023.pdf 2024 -> /assets/documents/pfic/{fund}-pfic-reporting-2024.pdf

families.name: CIBC Asset Management
families.notes: IMPORTANT: CIBC-branded mutual funds, CIBC Index Funds, Managed Portfolios and Axiom Portfolios receive NO statement. Renaissance and Imperial Pools do (see the renaissance family). Seeded as negatives in negatives.yaml.

families.name: BlackRock / iShares Canada
families.notes: The tax centre links only the "Fund List - PFIC Statements" roster, never the statements themselves, so this family is derived: read the roster for fund/ticker pairs, then probe the statement path per ticker and year. Two filename shapes are in use (-env1 and -en-v1) and BlackRock alternates between them inconsistently across years and funds, so both are tried. Misses are cached, so only the first run is expensive.

families.name: Capital Group Canada
families.notes: NOT CRAWLED, by their instruction. capitalgroup.com/robots.txt carries a blanket `Disallow: /content`, and every document including the PFIC statements lives under /content/dam/. They do publish statements - the tax centre states they are provided for all of their funds - so this is a crawling restriction, not an availability one. The tool deep-links the tax centre and you fetch by hand. Revisit if robots.txt changes.

families.name: Fidelity Investments Canada
families.notes: Reports per unit PER DAY - unit-days must be computed to file. Some funds run to April 30. Personalized statements are available on request for non-ETF series, which cannot be crawled.

families.name: iA Clarington Investments
families.notes: Needs a browser twice over. The raw HTML carries a stale 2021/2022 link list that now 404s; JavaScript replaces it with the current year on load. The PDFs themselves also reject non-browser TLS, answering requests/curl with a 404 HTML page while serving Chromium the real file.

families.name: Renaissance Investments (CIBC)
families.notes: Covers Renaissance funds, Renaissance Private Pools and Imperial Pools. Renaissance HISA and Money Market funds are excluded by the manager.

families.name: RBC Global Asset Management / PH&N
families.notes: Fund family -> fund -> series cascading menus, PDF revealed per selection. Series A, D, F, FT, H, I, O. Years 2021-2025 confirmed available. June 30 fiscal year end - do NOT assume December.

families.name: BMO Global Asset Management
families.notes: June 30 fiscal year end for most funds. PDFs live on bmogamhub.com.

families.name: Manulife Investment Management
families.notes: NOT login-gated. Rejects non-browser user agents with 403; serves 200 to a full browser header set. Per-fund landing pages under /retail/ca/en/resources/all/regulatory/{fund}-pfic-annual-information-statements

families.name: Global X Investments Canada (formerly Horizons)
families.notes: WordPress; PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/{YYYY}/{MM}/. Reports per unit PER DAY. Many funds renamed from Horizons to Global X, so the alias table matters here.

families.name: Purpose Investments
families.notes: The bookmarked page was a single fund page, not a hub. Real repository is documents.purposeinvest.com/Docs/BNC/pfic/en/{Fund Name} PFIC {YYYY-MM-DD}.pdf

families.name: Sun Life Global Investments
families.notes: Roughly 17 funds covered. Bot-blocks plain HTTP fetches.

negatives.scope: CIBC-branded mutual funds, CIBC Index Funds, CIBC Managed Portfolios, Axiom Portfolios
negatives.note: Manager states unitholders of these funds will not receive PFIC Annual Information Statements. Sister brands Renaissance and Imperial Pools DO receive them - same bank, opposite answer. This is the canonical case for why the register exists.

negatives.scope: Renaissance HISA, Renaissance Money Market funds
All funds held inside RRSPs and RRIFs
negatives.note: Managers generally do not issue statements for registered retirement accounts. Note this is about the manager's publishing practice only, and is not a conclusion about the treaty position or reporting obligation for any particular account type. TFSAs and RESPs are NOT covered by this exclusion and generally do need PFIC reporting.

negatives.scope: Fidelity Canada non-ETF mutual fund series
negatives.note: Only ETF and ETF Series statements are published on the website. Personalized statements for other series are issued on request, so absence from the index is not evidence that none can be obtained - call the manager.

Capital Group DOES publish PFIC Annual Information Statements for its Canadian funds - this is not a "no statement" finding. But capitalgroup.com/robots.txt sets a blanket `Disallow: /content`, and every document lives under /content/dam/, so the crawler will not fetch them. Open the tax centre and download by hand. If robots.txt is relaxed, drop the `access: manual` flag in sources.yaml and this entry.
